title: Global aggregator - daemon refresh with lazy TTL fallback
description: WHY: the global view needs current rollups without every command fanning out over N repos. WHAT: (1) daemon mode watching the runtime paths of linked (lifecycle state from sprint G1) registry entries and copying changed rollup.json files into a global cache directory keyed by project id, with per-project error isolation - one unreadable project marks that entry degraded, never fails the sweep; (2) lazy fallback inside bwrk global when no daemon runs: refresh cache entries older than the TTL by reading rollup files directly, honoring --live-cache-ttl-ms; (3) the aggregate read API returns rollup plus cache metadata (fetchedAt, source daemon-or-lazy, staleness) so consumers can render honesty badges; (4) respect the MCP-daemon boundary doc - the daemon observes and copies projections, it never writes project truth (docs/architecture/MCP_DAEMON_BOUNDARY.md and DAEMON.md).
acceptanceCriteria: Daemon sweep refreshes rollups for linked projects only and isolates a broken project as degraded, covered by tests
Lazy fallback serves fresh-enough rollups without a daemon and marks staleness beyond TTL
